answer_1.quote: Generative model-based CAs are mostly developed using deep learning techniques such as recurrent neural networks (RNNs) or transformers, which learn from large amounts of text data and generate responses based on the learned patterns and structures.

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation using survey assessment is the most prevalent method to gauge mental health CAs' performance.
answer_4.guideline: collecting user feedback on CA models (usability, difficulty, appropriateness), or asking a group of individuals to annotate user logs or utterances to collect passive feedbacks (self-disclosure level, competence, motivational).
